newsitem.title: USA: Hasbro sets three-for-two stock split.
newsitem.headline: Hasbro sets three-for-two stock split.

text.p: Hasbro Inc said Thursday its board of directors has declared a three-for-two stock split payable in the form of a 50-percent stock dividend.

The company said the board also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share, which represents a 20-percent increase over the quarterly cash dividend previously in effect, as adjusted for the stock split.
The company said the stock split will be payable on March 21 to shareholders of record on March 7.
The cash dividend will be payable on May 15 to shareholders of record on May 1, it added. Hasbro had paid $0.10 per share quarterly on a presplit basis.
Hasbro designs, manufactures and markets toys, games, interactive software, puzzles and infant care products under names like Playskool, Kenner, Tonka, Milton Bradley and Parker Brothers.
